subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

PRKY_LDP_ _YOLD_RKYO_DPRK_ _LD
solution:
Given : PRKY_LDP_ _YOLD_RKYO_DPRK_ _LD 

By checking options :

 
• ORKLPOD → PRKY__O__LDP__RK__YOLD**__L__**RKYO**__P__**DPRK__**OD**__LD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern) 
 
• ORPKYLP → PRKY__O__LDP__RP__YOLD**__K__**RKYO__Y__DPRK__L____P__LD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ORPLKYO → PRKY__O__LDP__RP__YOLD__L__RKYO__K__DPRK__Y____O__LD → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ORKPLYO → PRKY__**O**__LDP__**RK**__YOLD__**P**__RKYO__**L**__DPRK__**Y**____**O**__LD → (It follows the pattern of : PRKYOLD - PRKYOLD - PRKYOLD - PRKYOLD)

⇒Option - (4) gives the pattern of "PRKY__O__LD - P__RK__YOLD - __P__RKYO__L__D - PRK__Y____O__LD"

Hence, "**ORKPLYO**" is the correct answer.
